full_page.content:
1935, October
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 47 Cont.
Oct. 1 M. Dionne Mother of 4 small ch. bleeding to death from Extracted teeth. 4th Oct. Letter reports Margaret O.K. - Thank God.
2 Mrs. Ag. Lindsey - middle aged - broke collar-bone four weeks ago - poor set - fears it will have to be re-broken ...
Eda Olve Walsh - 68 - neuritis
Donald Watson - 5 - of Pt. Huron - partly paralysed ... defective vertibrae
Blank Page
Page 48 Page 49 Oct. 3 Archie Catellier - 28 - T. B. four yrs. ago - leaves hospital in Bat- tle Creek before cured. Early part of last month took ill again and X-ray showed trouble in both lungs cavities. Came to Monastery. En- rolled in Ser. Mass Assoc'n promising weekly communion for a year and quite a number of enrollments for the PP. SS. if things turned better. X-ray then taken in Kiefer Hosp'1 showed OK Oct. 30, 1935. Mother & 2 Sisters here To-day - Hospital authorities Surprised. A.C. working O.K. every day ... "cured"
Jack Strachan - 35 - N.Cath. - vanished Aug. 25th - no word to friends from
Nettie B. Lutz - 38 - doctoring two yrs for heart ..... nothing helps. Promises more frequent Communion.
6 Wm. Crowley - 65 - dying of diabetis - infected with gangreen. Thought to be dead at 7 a.m. Oct. 2nd - last Wed'y. Prayed for that day now out of danger. Thank God.
Page 50 Oct. 9th Aline Bissonette - 23 - keeping undesirable company .... little faith left, if any.
Peter J. Frass - 68 - kidney trouble, has had a number of operations already, fears to go to hospital for another ... is enrolled To-day - promising more frequent Communion if thing go favorable ....
1000 cancered man died last Wed. Oct. 2nd - buried Saturday 5th .... Thanks.
